components.text: Trips per day rose from 62.6 million to 66.2 million, up 5.7%
The travel rush is another count: 9.41 billion cross-region trips over 40 days in 2026, going home and to work included, not tourism. Nor can the rise be credited to the listing.

footnote: Source: Ministry of Culture and Tourism (Feb 2025, Feb 2026), Ministry of Transport (Apr 2026)
notes: In December 2024 the Spring Festival was inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List. The ministry called the 2025 holiday the first Spring Festival after inscription. Over that 8-day holiday, people made 501 million domestic trips and spent 677.0 billion yuan. The 2026 holiday lasted 9 days, one day longer, with 596 million trips and 803.5 billion yuan spent. Because the holidays differ in length, a per-day comparison is fairer: 62.6 million trips a day, then 66.2 million, up 5.7 percent. That rise cannot be credited to the inscription, since many things drive holiday travel. And the travel-rush figure you often hear is another count altogether: 9.41 billion cross-region trips over the 40 days of the 2026 travel season, which includes people going home and going to work, not just tourism.
